tools.description: Checks a PDF from a public https URL for technical accessibility prerequisites, like the PDF check at https://demo.aufblatt.de/pdf-check: document title, language, tags, text on all pages, headings and their order, alternative text of figures, link names. Returns a status per item (ok, missing, part

tools.name: create_demo_flipbook
tools.description: Downloads a PDF from a public https URL and turns it into a browsable flipbook demo on https://demo.aufblatt.de, like https://demo.aufblatt.de/demo. The demo is public to anyone with its link, not indexed by search engines, and deleted after 48 hours. Stored until deletion: the PDF and the catalogue

tools.name: get_demo_status
tools.description: Returns the state of a demo created with create_demo_flipbook: queued (with the number of demos ahead), running (with progress 0 to 1), ready (with the catalogue URL and deletion time) or failed (with the reason). Unknown and expired demo_ids give the same answer. Deutsch: Stand der Aufbereitung, da

tools.name: calculate_price
tools.description: Calculates the yearly price of Aufblatt for a number of published issues (catalogues, magazines, manuals), with line items, setup fee, first-year total and tax note, from the same data as https://aufblatt.de/preise/. Deutsch: Jahrespreis für n Ausgaben wie auf der Preisseite.

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Returns researched facts about other flipbook and ePaper providers from the comparison at https://aufblatt.de/vergleich/, each fact with its source URL on the provider’s own site and the retrieval date. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: pdf_check, create_demo_flipbook, get_demo_status · Private data: pdf_check, create_demo_flipbook · Public sink: create_demo_flipbook.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: pdf_check, create_demo_flipbook, get_demo_status · Private data: pdf_check, create_demo_flipbook · Public sink: create_demo_flipbook

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
